presentation.label: LIGHT TAPS
presentation.summary: Plays the light pad taps the Rytm normally ignores, as a soft hit.
presentation.overview: The Rytm's pads report a light tap as a press but send it no strike, so stock plays nothing, though the same tap still toggles a mute. With LIGHT TAPS on, a pad press that gets no strike within 3 ms plays the pad at a low velocity (8 of 255), just below the softest hit the pads report. Real hits are untouched and keep their velocity. Off, the pads behave exactly as on stock.
highlights: Light pad taps play instead of being ignored
Real hits keep the pads' own velocity
One switch in the GLOBAL menu, saved with the project
usage: Press GLOBAL and scroll down past SYSTEM to LIGHT TAPS: OFF.
Press YES: the row reads LIGHT TAPS: ON. Leave the menu.
Tap a pad lightly with a fingertip: it plays as a soft hit. Hit it harder: it plays with the pads' own velocity, as on stock.

access.location: The GLOBAL menu, after SYSTEM: LIGHT TAPS: OFF or ON.
steps: Press GLOBAL and scroll down past SYSTEM to LIGHT TAPS: OFF.
Press YES: the row reads LIGHT TAPS: ON.
Tap a pad lightly: it plays as a soft hit. Press YES on the row again to turn it off.

limitations: Every light tap plays at the same velocity: the pads report no force for a light tap, so there is nothing to grade it by.
A light tap plays about 3 ms after its press, the time the module waits for a strike that never comes.

load.display: No measurable change: audio load L 71-73 % with and without Light Taps, peak 75 % against 76 %
load.conditions: @filefolder's Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, 2026-11-23 (reported). The same project and pattern playing, with light taps and firm hits, for about 30 s per build. A throwaway readout of core-ar2's core_audio_load (never committed) showed the busiest block per second and the peak since boot. LD0A, the plain base and the readout: L 71-73 %, peak 76 %. LD0B, the same plus Light Taps as in LT03, LIGHT TAPS ON: L 71-73 %, peak 75 %. Light Taps runs in the panel task, not the audio interrupt.

tests.summary: Build LT03 (plain base, sha256 72cad00c) on @filefolder's Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, as reported: light taps play, hard hits play once at stock level, mutes and selection unchanged, and every light tap plays through 15 s after a firm hit (the 4,096 ms case). Beside Silent Pad+Trig Settings (LS03) every check passed. Audio load: L 71-73 %, peak 75 % with Light Taps against 71-73 %, peak 76 % without. Host test: 12 timing cases.
